recipes.name: Curried Carrot & Potato Soup
instructions: Heat the oil in a large pot over high heat. Cook the onion until lightly caramelized, about 5 to 7 minutes. Add splashes of water as needed to deglaze the pot.
Add the garlic and all the spices. Cook for another 2 minutes.
Then add the remaining ingredients, except for the quinoa. Bring to a boil, then reduce to a simmer. Cook for 15 minutes, or until the potatoes have softened.
Using an immersion blender, purée the soup to the desired consistency. If using a standing blender, we recommend blending half, so that some small chunks remain.
Serve alongside some cooked quinoa, or with croutons. Enjoy!

page_recipe_notes: Storage Store in an airtight container in the fridge for up to 4 days. Store in the freezer for up to 2 months.
